author: Unity
description:
Get tips and advice from Neil Jones a.k.a. Aerial_Knight, the Unity developer behind games like Never Yield, We Never Yield, and most recently, DropShot. 

You’ll learn about: 
✅ The “two-week rule” for prototyping and testing new ideas 
✅ Using Timeline for cutscenes AND gameplay
✅ Custom tools for efficiently reusing assets and animations across projects

Neil also offers parting advice for aspiring game devs: “Stop waiting. Just make games!”

🔗 Play Aerial_Knight’s DropShot: https://on.unity.com/Aerial_Knights_DropShot
🔗 Explore more Made with Unity games: https://on.unity.com/UnitySteam
